escapes.name: T1 straight-ahead escape
escapes.source_note: Opening left turn with a straight paved escape. Preserve the close temporary spectator structures, following T2 arm and separate pit exit. Footprint dimensions are bounded reference/map reconstruction estimates, not measured barrier coordinates. The existing racing centreline, width, elevation and camera remain fixed.

escapes.name: T3 straight-ahead escape
escapes.source_note: Opening third-corner escape remains ordinary asphalt. Preserve the returned racing arm and the protected public-road edge. Footprint dimensions are bounded reference/map reconstruction estimates, not measured barrier coordinates. The existing racing centreline, width, elevation and camera remain fixed.

paint_role_review.source: Saved/Refs/singapore.mp4; supplied edited-reference event year unverified
paint_role_review.observation: The detailed 534 s main-straight view places the yellow/blue apron on driver RIGHT beside the spectator wall; garages are LEFT. The 590 s grid and 594 s reverse external view confirm that main-road spectator-side role. The previous driver-LEFT 4.6 m solid-yellow band was incorrectly registered and crosses the mapped pit fast lane.

original_controls.sampler: Exact previous CircuitScene.at samples at a maximum 2 m spacing; native 4940 m wraps to the first road sample.

paint_role_review.correction: Reclassify Yellow to existing Runoff only inside these exact original footprints. Preserve every White/dash/kerb, all geometry/attributes and outside material. No opposite-side painted pattern or physics change is added.
paint_role_review.status: Source-supported material correction; actual native and cooked validation remain separate.
